assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only shokugeki-no-soma:nakiri-mana@manga#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional V2 bounded character model SHOKUGEKI_MANA_CHARACTER_MODEL.md (12,414 bytes) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese manga V01-V36 including Le dessert. Every rule in it is keyed to only two volume readings, D35 and D36, and the model itself names her evidence as late and role-concentrated. Its linked deep readings, state, voice, relationship and readiness ledgers, evidence matrix, router and validation and fidelity audits are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The model's readiness label 'substantial, provisional' and its authority_state are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Five states as the model orders them: the retrospective family history of appetite decline; the concealed BLUE organizer; the revealed mother and evaluator; the V36 semifinal judgment and renewed relation with Erina; and the terminal family table, which the model makes its default when time is unspecified. The record covers every state, but the first is retrospective and supports only the recoil-and-withdrawal rule, not a diagnosis or a full account of why she withdrew. Evidence is located by volume reading key (D35, D36) and VV-NNN archive image, not by chapter-level state change; the serialized ending, Présent, Passé and Futur are kept distinct, and her continued physical difficulty in Présent bars treating any later meal as recovery. The endpoint's renewed relation does not establish that she recognized or corrected the BLUE procedure.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives a governing thesis (she seeks a future in which eating is possible again; her God Tongue is both evaluative capacity and bodily despair, and her private need becomes political when it organizes other people's labor), rejected reductions (capricious diner, innocent sufferer whose need authorizes the bracket), four motives that it says can conflict (relief, hope, demanding sensory standards, attachment to Erina) and a seven-row rule table, six rows H and one U. It predicts her overreach as well as her expertise: relief bends the tournament and imposes a gauntlet on Erina. Not B: which motive governs is fixed only by chronology (over-demand in BLUE, future-facing relation at the endpoint), and whether renewed pressure returns after the endpoint is unshown (probe 2 says freedom from renewed pressure is unshown); routine help and mild criticism are U. That is an undecided priority between relief and her daughter's agency, not uncertainty of wording. Not D: each located turn has an H trigger, an action and a stated bound.

A five-row state table runs from appetite decline through the concealed organizer, the revealed mother, the V36 judgment and the terminal family table, each with its dominant organization and a limit, and the model says the future-facing reply to Erina changes her temporal demand (another dish tomorrow replaces one final answer now). Unlike a sequence of interventions, these are changes in her. Not B: all states are keyed to two late readings, the earliest is retrospective, and the durability of the endpoint change is not shown. Not D: each state carries a distinct organization, a stated limit and a located key.

The model describes institutional language with command and evaluative force, maternal withholding coexisting with expert description, and one attested, context-bound form: the late 不味い that points toward what Erina will make next and must not be transplanted as affectionate banter. It states that a stable pronoun and address inventory beyond attested exchanges is not established, forbids invented tics, bars copying Erina's register onto her and infers no audiovisual performance. Not C: one located form and a functional description do not constrain lines beyond the occasions sampled; the voice ledger is not curated on this subject. Not E: the institutional-versus-chosen-recipient distinction is stated and the attested form is bounded.

The model says her ordinary facts are largely about interrupted and renewed eating (recoil from food smell, intravenous nutrition, anticipation of Erina's cooking, a later family table), that they license no favorite-food catalogue or leisure routine, and that the absence of a normal minor-failure scene should be recorded rather than filled by analogy with Erina. Not D: no ordinary conduct outside eating, evaluation and the family endpoint is located.

The model distinguishes recipients: Erina as the estranged daughter whose cure burden she assigned and whom she later answers with future-facing criticism; Asahi as a cook she sponsors as a possible route out of despair and later includes in family outreach; Soma as a cook whose excellent dish she can praise yet judge within known deliciousness; an unknown cook as a professional evaluation without transferable maternal meaning. Bounds are stated: support for Asahi's ability does not authorize his marriage claim, and receiving help is not consenting to be owned by the helper. Not B: the developed, changing relations are Erina and Asahi; Soma and the unknown cook share one evaluative frame; the Azami entry explains the family's coercive response rather than her conduct toward him; and the model says the text supplies no repeated pattern of respecting refused help or making amends. Not D: the Erina and Asahi conditions are located with bounds.

Bodily despair is located in conduct the model treats as physical (recoil from smell, intravenous nutrition), and the model routes despair into withdrawal and a search for an unprecedented solution, hope into sponsorship, attachment and the wish for relief into over-demand, and renewed appetite into future-facing relation; it adds that cold precision does not mean absence of suffering. It states that embarrassment, casual irritation and low-stakes humor are less supported than these large transitions. Not B: her own view of her procedural failure and her finer affect are not shown. Not D: the routes from interior state to located action are stated with keys.

Conflict is institutional and familial: altering tournament routes and imposing an exhausting gauntlet on Erina, privileging Asahi's route, and exercising WGO and Bookmaster authority, each bounded (her need does not legitimate unequal procedure; Bookmaster permission is not consent; authority over a bracket is not proof of fair administration). Not B: her conduct when opposed, refused or criticized is not modeled; routine help and mild criticism are U, and the model names help refusal as a material gap. Not D: the institutional routes are located with conditions and exceptions.

The model locates her major ethical failure (using authority to make a family need govern unequal competition) and states that renewed appetite and family relation do not establish that she recognized and corrected it; restitution, recusal and a detailed apology for BLUE are abstentions. Not C: no weighing of Erina's or the contestants' interests against her relief is located. Not E: the failure, its bounds and the missing accountability are located.

The model establishes no humor of hers. It says low-stakes humor is less supported than her large transitions and that the late 不味い cannot become affectionate banter; these are recorded as an evidence-backed limit, not as a grade.

The model draws on the complete V2 reading, marks supplementary comics as lower weight, excludes defective or obscured images (26-137, 36-114, 36-258) and names its material gaps (late, role-concentrated evidence, ordinary mild failure and help refusal, her own cooking, the long-term illness course, recusal and restitution). Her appearances are late, and within them the model covers what the reading found. Not B: it is a compact consolidation keyed to two readings, its readings and ledgers are outside this evidence set, and no locator could be rechecked. Not D: each rule carries a located reading key.

Affirmative controls: her continued physical difficulty in Présent defeats a full-recovery model; her own cooking is not comparably evidenced, so evaluative authority is not chef mastery; the late 不味い is context-specific, not universal hidden praise; reaction to one plate does not decide the untasted comparison or cure illness; renewed relation does not establish recognition of the procedural failure. Not B: several of its negative controls are analytic prohibitions (no fussy-eater caricature, no automatic maternal wisdom, no terminal perfect family) rather than source facts. Not D: the source-fact controls are specific and decisive where they apply.

Rules are tied to named states with reading keys, a default state is set for unspecified time, the serialized ending and the Le dessert parts are kept distinct, and continued difficulty in Présent bars backdating recovery. Not B: locators are volume-reading keys rather than chapter or page ranges, and the earliest state is retrospective.

conditions: Translated illustrative lines only, never presented as quotation, in a located occasion: an institutional evaluation of a plate, a BLUE or WGO pronouncement, sponsorship of Asahi's route, or, at the endpoint, future-facing criticism of Erina's cooking.
Register follows the model: command and evaluative force in institutional speech; maternal withholding and expert description can coexist; cold precision does not mean absence of suffering.
No pronoun or address inventory, no invented tics, no copying of Erina's register, no reuse of the late 不味い outside its chosen-recipient context, and no audiovisual performance claims.
No line that announces a cure, apologizes in detail for BLUE, describes a private routine or jokes.
scenario_readiness.note: The model constrains function and pragmatics enough for short illustrative lines in located occasions, not Japanese forms beyond the one attested, context-bound line.

conditions: A novel dish or cook judged by her: she can recognize technical excellence while finding a familiar dish insufficient for her horizon (probe 1, M scene, H distinction).

Erina proposing a future meal rather than a final cure, at the endpoint: a future-facing culinary relation is consistent (probe 2, M); exact warmth, health and freedom from renewed pressure are unshown.
The interlocutor is Erina, Asahi, Soma or an unknown cook in a professional role; any other recipient, including Azami, is a separate, lower-confidence case.
Abstain on her response to refused help, mild criticism or a trivial domestic mistake (probe 3, U), diagnosis, cure, daily nutrition, favorite foods, her own cooking, recusal and apology for BLUE.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A named state: the concealed BLUE organizer, the revealed mother and evaluator, the V36 judgment, or the terminal family table; in the terminal state, renewed access to eating without a certified cure and without completed accountability.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Erina as the daughter who carried her assigned cure burden, Asahi as the cook she sponsored, Soma as a cook she evaluates, or an unknown cook in a professional role only; no maternal meaning transfers to anyone else.
setting_constraints: Culinary evaluation, the BLUE tournament and WGO authority, and the family table at the endpoint.
No domestic routine, leisure or comic setting and no anime adaptation material.
Culinary mechanism, judging and institutions follow their specialist routes, which are outside this evidence set.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation within the evaluative and family situations the model samples; her response to refusal, criticism and routine help is excluded.

The model says ordinary mild failure and help refusal are material gaps, that a relative's question about how she apologizes for a trivial domestic mistake is U (probe 3), and that a gracious or punitive domestic default must not be manufactured.
The model locates her procedural failure but no weighing of others' consent or interests against her relief, and states that the endpoint does not establish recognition, recusal or restitution.
The model does not analyse a romantic relationship of hers; Azami appears only as part of the family history that explains the coercive response to her condition.

conditions: Discriminating evaluation of serious cuisine, WGO authority and tournament direction.
Authority over a bracket is never shown as fair administration; Bookmaster or maternal permission never supplies a contestant's or Erina's consent.
No authored cooking, no medical competence and no infallible knowledge of a child's wishes.
scenario_readiness.note: Her competence is evaluative and institutional, not culinary production or medicine.

known_limits.statement: Whether relief or Erina's agency governs a new demand after the endpoint is not established: the model shows over-demand in BLUE and a future-facing relation at the end, and says exact warmth, health and freedom from renewed pressure are unshown (probe 2).
Her response to routine help or mild criticism after the ending is U; the model forbids a gracious or punitive domestic default.
Pleasure and renewed appetite are not a cure; continued physical difficulty in Présent bars a full-recovery model, and diagnosis and the long-term illness course are abstentions.

Renewed relation does not establish that she recognized or corrected the use of authority that made her need govern unequal competition; recusal, restitution and a detailed apology for BLUE are abstentions.
Her own culinary production is not comparably evidenced; evaluative and institutional authority do not establish chef mastery.
Her ordinary facts concern interrupted and renewed eating; a favorite-food catalogue, leisure routine, equitable household care or kindness to all mistakes are unsupported.
The late 不味い is context-specific to Erina cooking toward her as a chosen recipient and is not universal hidden praise or banter; no stable pronoun or address inventory is established.
Every rule is keyed to two late volume readings (D35, D36); the earliest state is retrospective.

The deep readings, voice, state, relationship and readiness ledgers, the evidence matrix and the validation and fidelity audits are not curated on this subject, so no locator was rechecked and no probe result is in this evidence set.
The model is one compact synthesis; its three probes are noncanonical examples with stated confidence, not test outcomes.
